open_points.text: “Two ceilings no release changes” and “stored_value_bytes_max, json_depth_max -> unchanged by every release” conflict with “A release that must change one first decides how those runs are read; until then both keep their release v1 values.”
open_points.question: Are `stored_value_bytes_max` and `json_depth_max` permanently immutable across every release, or may a later release change either after defining how existing runs are read?
options: They are permanently fixed at their release-v1 values.
A later release may change them if that release also defines a migration or versioned trace-reading rule.
open_points.default_guess: Treat both ceilings as permanently fixed at their release-v1 values.
